turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is about the overdue balance on your personal loan. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes. Money has been tight since August.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for telling me. What could you manage, and when?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Shifts at the plant got cut in August, I can do $1,000 by the 15th.

T-8812.summary: Customer reports reduced shifts since August; promised $1,000 by 15 Sep.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The $1,000 payment we discussed did not come through. What happened?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I still have no full shifts. I can do $800 by October 2nd.

T-8843.summary: Broken PTP acknowledged; new PTP $800 by 2 Oct. Hours still reduced.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My income dropped this quarter, what are my options?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We can look at a reduced payment plan. Let me check what fits.

T-8901.summary: Self-employed customer reports income drop; asked about payment plan options.
